KNOWLEDGE SHARING PLATFORM FOR STUDENTS
StuDocu sets knowledge free. Be it lecture notes, summaries, study guides, etc.: students can exchange resources on this platform & excel together. Studocu was founded in 2013 by four students to exchange study documents with each other and together strive for better grades.

Since then, millions of study documents have been shared by students and are accessible to everyone in the world. As of October 2022, there are more than 34 million students using Studocu to access high-quality materials every month. Not only to view or download the best study materials but also to get study-related questions answered by subject-matter experts or peers. Studocu’s mission is to empower everyone to excel in their studies by providing the best tools to students who want to study more efficiently.

ABOUT THE FOUNDERS

Studocu was founded by four alumni of Delft University of Technology: Marnix Broer, Lucas van den Houten, Jacques Huppes, and Sander Kuijk. 

Marnix Broer, co-founder, holds an MSc in Offshore Engineering. Over the past 10 years, Marnix has grown Studocu from a Dutch sharing platform to a global student community that helps students excel in their studies and life. Marnix is also founder of Platform Elektrisch Vervoer (PEV), the Dutch platform for electric transportation on the internet, and co-founder of TentamenTrainingen.nl, the company which helps university students in the Netherlands prepare for their exams. 

Lucas van den Houten, co-founder and CPO, has known Marnix since childhood. He holds an MSc in Mechanical Engineering. After university, he co-founded a webdesign company with Sander Kujik, co-founder and VP Technology. After their collective experience in website development, Marnix called upon Lucas and Sander to build the very first version of Studocu, after which they grew into the roles of CPO and VP Technology respectively. 

Jacques Huppes, co-founder, no longer plays an active role in Studocu but remains an advisor. He is co-founder of BRGHT.com, the candidate aptitude insights platform. 

Sander Kuijk is co-founder and VP Technology of Studocu, bringing cutting edge technology into the conservative education space.

THE STRAVA FOR MOTORSPORT
Track Titan is the biggest learning and social platform for racing enthusiasts around the world.

The company is building the "Strava for Motorsport" by combining AI driving tips with social and community features. Track Titan’s AI coach makes elite-level coaching accessible to gamers and drivers of all abilities, helping them improve their technique and connect with a global community of fellow fans on games including EA’s F1 series and iRacing, and in the real world.

With more than 200,000 members and a ten-fold growth in ARR over the last two years, Track Titan is able to ingest and process data from more than 10 different racing games and is on the verge of launching real-life race cars.

Founded in London in 2021, the company has also partnered with major manufacturers, including MOZA and Fanatec, to integrate their software into the gaming hardware that gives racers a more immersive experience.

ABOUT THE FOUNDERS

Max Teichert is the founder and CEO of Track Titan. He is a former professional simracer who managed the jump into professional real-world racing and coaching for Porsche. Max was one of the first employees in three startups that raised $200M+ by VCs such as Picus, Tiger, and Lightrock. After spending years honing his skills online, Max launched a professional racing career after success in the Gran Turismo Academy. Track Titan was founded to make the elite-level coaching and insights Max had benefited from accessible to gamers and drivers of all abilities. He holds a Bachelor’s in Management from the University of Bath.

AI-POWERED PAYROLL OS
Alassio is an open, interoperable payroll OS for accounting firms and their end clients, designed to streamline workflows and turn data into actionable insights.

Founded in July 2025 and built for a market under intense margin pressure and constrained by outdated legacy tools, Alassio (ex-Rivage) helps firms run payroll operations faster, with fewer manual steps and greater reliability.

At its core, Alassio is developing a next-generation payroll engine capable of covering a broad range of French collective agreements, which define industry-specific payroll rules and compliance logic. Alassio's approach is to automate compliance through an AI-powered workflow that supports continuous legal monitoring and improves the explainability of payroll calculations.

On top of this foundation, Alassio is building a business platform that integrates natively with the broader HR and payroll SaaS ecosystem (e.g. workforce management and financial tooling). By structuring and distributing trusted payroll data across systems, Alassio enables productivity gains for payroll teams and supports a shift from repetitive execution to higher-value, data-driven social and payroll advisory for SMEs.

ABOUT THE FOUNDERS

Alassio was born from the meeting of two complementary engineering/sales tandems.

Tancrède d’Hauteville is the co-founder and CEO of Alassio. An HEC Paris graduate, Tancrède previously interned in Investment Banking at Lazard and in Private Equity at Silver Lake.

Paul Lemoine is the co-founder of Alassio. A CentraleSupélec graduate, he built and led delivery of complex software projects at FABDEV, including mission-critical systems for Enterprise clients.

Ayoub Saidane is the co-founder of Alassio. He graduated from École Polytechnique, and has an AI/math background with research experience at UC Berkeley.

Hector de Vergeron is the co-founder of Alassio. He is an HEC Paris graduate and previously interned in early and late stage startups (Mirakl), and early-stage VC firms.

FRONTLINE INTELLIGENCE. DRIVING OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE
FYLD is an AI-native frontline intelligence platform for critical infrastructure organisations running complex, high-risk field operations.

Founded in London in 2020, FYLD turns frontline work into a real-time source of operational intelligence, embedding AI-powered risk detection and live visibility into workflows to eliminate time-consuming paperwork and help managers prioritize the sites that pose the most risk.

Field teams capture short videos instead of completing static forms, and FYLD’s AI analyzes conditions to identify safety, quality, and delivery risks before they escalate. Managers get live visibility across jobs without adding site visits or headcount, and every action is automatically documented for compliance and audit purposes.

In 2025, FYLD expanded its US footprint, adding customers including Kiewit Corporation, Quanta Services, Emery Sapp & Sons, and Sulzer, alongside longstanding partners such as Ferrovial.

ABOUT THE FOUNDERS

Shelley Copsey is the CEO of FYLD. She has over 25 years of experience in the intersection of physical infrastructure and digital technologies, as well as the human transformation required to deliver on the promise of emerging technologies. Shelley has created and led multiple enterprise SaaS start-ups in this domain, including GeoSLAM, a world-leading geospatial company that transformed the way the real world was mapped (exited to Faro). She was also a founding board member at Coviu, an award-winning telehealth platform that scaled from 400 to 25,000 consultations a day during the Covid-19 pandemic. She is a Chartered Accountant and has undertaken executive education at MIT and Stanford on AI and corporate entrepreneurship. Shelley has received numerous awards and accolades, including 2025 Sifted 100 Fastest Growing Start-Ups and 2025 EY Entrepreneur of the Year - London Region Finalist.
